regions.full_page: Many thanks for your kind favor just read and noted. I tried to get you on the phone last Monday and then with so many calling and so much hustling, etc, I failed to get you afterwards. I certainly would like also to have spoken to your dear Father. Of course, I sympathise with you all in your problems, especially that of being without a roof over your heads. But why make so much of that after all? How many millions have in addition to that lamentation , hardly a bite of food to put in their mouth? Why not make a virtue of a necessity or emergency by offering it all to the Heavenly Father in union with the situation in which Jesus found Himself when not in com- plaint or lamentation He whispered to the youth who proposed to be His disciple: " .... The Son of Man hath not where to lay his Head." But alas! Humanity's outstanding weakness seems to be a thoughtless want of appreciation for the uncountable blessings by which Almighty God is always surrounding it; and no doubt the Krausmans as well as the Kennedys and the KCs are no exception in part of that old humanity. But how incalculably fortunate we are after all that the merciful God has patience with us and notwithstanding such failings has patience with us and still manifests His solicitude for our welfare in such a next-to infinite number of ways? Let us, therefore, shake off the spirit of complaint and lamentation over triffling difficulties that, even though unpleasant for nature and for the thoughtless, who make little of an eternal happiness awaiting those who persevere in, at least resignation to poverty and, which dif- ficulties can so easily be turned to such vast advantage.

regions.full_page: Hoping this finds things brightening around you and that the next time I get to Det., even if only a day or two, that I'll get you at least on the phone, I remain, Sincerely yours in +o in Christ,
